Name: Pirate Furniture and Decorations for Alternative Textures
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Alternative Textures - Pirate Furniture and Decor
[/b][/size][size=4]Decorate with Pirate furniture!  Content pack with over 75 texture changes based off of the pirate's grotto on ginger island.  [b]Requires the mod Alternative Textures. 
[/b][/size][b]
[/b][size=5][b]Just paint onto any of the following furniture items from the catalog:
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Big Beds[/size]
[*][size=3]Bookcases (2 x 3)[/size]
[*]Chairs
[*]vases and barrels
[*][size=3]End tables[/size]
[*][size=3]Tea Tables[/size]
[*][size=3]Tabletop plants and small decor[/size]
[*][size=3]Houseplants[/size]
[*][size=3]Medium rugs (2 x 3)[/size]
[*][size=3]Small Paintings (1 x 2)[/size]
[*][size=3]Tall paintings and banners (1 x 3)[/size]
[*][size=3]Square paintings (2 x 2)[/size]
[*][size=3]Flooring[/size]
[*][size=3]Wallpaper[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Textures include:[/size]
[/b][list]
[*][size=3]Barrels[/size]
[*][size=3]Cannon[/size]
[*][size=3]Jolly Roger Flag[/size]
[*][size=3]Skulls[/size]
[*][size=3]Wine and ale[/size]
[*][size=3]Parrot[/size]
[*][size=3]Anchors[/size]
[*][size=3]Row Boat[/size]
[*][size=3]Portholes[/size]
[*][size=3]Ship interiors[/size]
[*][size=3]Swords[/size]
[*][size=3]Treasure[/size]
[*][size=3]Exotic Plants[/size]
[*][size=3]Tables[/size]
[*][size=3]Shipping Crates[/size]
[*][size=3]Pirate Beds[/size]
[/list][list]
[/list]
[size=5][b]How to Use
[/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Install Alternative Textures Mod[/size]
[*][size=3]Purchase the paint bucket from Robin[/size]
[*][size=3]Use the paint bucket on any of the catalog furniture, decor and craftables listed above[/size]
[/list]
